title: Music for Two Dancers
description: A monumental, horizontal piece from the Dreamy Softness series, this painting is deeply rooted in nostalgia and the passing of time. Inspired by an old photograph of a couple frozen in happiness in front of their newly built home, the artwork translates this vintage warmth into a contemporary, poetic space. Rendered in acrylic on raw cotton canvas, the composition is dominated by the expansive back of a man’s white shirt as he holds hands with his partner in a dance posture. Developed alongside my poem Music for Two Dancers, the visual rhythm builds toward the text's final, haunting line: 'the careful solitude of two heads.' Within the signature palette of translucent pinks and greens, the figures embody a profound intimacy - a sacred, quiet sanctuary shared between two minds amidst the fading echoes of yesterday.
